item.title: Pittsburgh doctor killed while he slept was "loved by all"
item.description: Dr. Idris Evans, the Pittsburgh doctor killed in a violent home invasion, is being remembered for his kindness and compassion.

item.title: Supreme Court lets Trump administration use SAVE database for now
item.description: In a 6-3 decision, the Supreme Court sided with the Trump administration in its push to use a controversial database to review state voter rolls for potential noncitizens.

item.title: 30 partially clothed men found in frat basement in alleged hazing incident
item.description: Two 20-year-olds have been arrested and charged with hazing and disorderly conduct in relation to the incident.

item.title: Democrats are gaining steam in some red states, according to Cook Political Report
item.description: Democrats have made some gains in several key Senate races, according to the Cook Political Report. CBS News' Caitlin Huey-Burns has the latest.

item.title: Iran proposes a 7-day plan to reopen the Strait of Hormuz
item.description: Iran's president says Tehran wants a deal with the U.S. before November's midterm elections, as the regime puts an offer on the table.

item.title: Trump-Xi visit to Washington wraps up with few achievements announced
item.description: President Trump hosted Chinese President Xi Jinping for a state dinner on Thursday, as the world's two most powerful countries extend a tariff truce and grapple with a rivalry on advanced AI.

item.title: Pittsburgh doctor attacked and killed while he slept, wife also stabbed
item.description: Dr. Idris Evans, a physician and medical director from UPMC Children's Hospital in Pittsburgh, was stabbed to death in his bed early Thursday.

item.title: DOJ says it has ended more than 50 decades-old school desegregation cases
item.description: The Justice Department said Thursday it has ended more than 50 long-standing consent decrees dating back decades that sought to curb unlawful racial segregation that was prevalent during the Jim Crow era.

item.title: Hurricane Polo is a powerful Category 5 storm off Mexico. See its path.
item.description: Hurricane Polo regained Category 5 status as its intensity fluctuated between Category 4 and Category 5 — the strongest on the hurricane scale — off Mexico's southwestern coast.

item.title: Ukrainian kids learn to fly drones for a future shaped by Russia's invasion
item.description: A Ukrainian nonprofit group is teaching kids to make, service and fly simple drones, to help them be "useful in the future in their country."

item.title: Ohio sheriff says Republicans, Democrats don't "have the guts" to fix U.S. immigration system
item.description: Richard Jones, the sheriff of Butler County, Ohio, joins CBS News 24/7 to talk about the need to fix the U.S. immigration system and calls out Republicans and Democrats for lack of action.

item.title: U.S. is "ready to help" Cuba, State Department spokesperson says amid internal Army memo
item.description: The U.S. military is laying the groundwork for potential action in Cuba, a memo obtained by CBS News suggests. U.S. State Department spokesperson Tommy Pigott comments on U.S.-Cuba relations, the Iran war and more.

item.title: Duckworth slams Trump's "foolhardy plan" to make triumphal arch a military complex
item.description: Democratic Sen. Tammy Duckworth of Illinois is demanding the Pentagon and Federal Aviation Administration reject President Trump's call to convert plans for a massive triumphal arch into a "top grade Military Complex."

item.title: Powerful nor'easter to bring more flooding to Northeast; Hawaii braces for Hurricane Nolo
item.description: A powerful nor'easter threatens to bring more flooding and damaging winds as it moves up the East Coast. CBS News' Tom Hanson has more on the nor'easter, and Carter Evans has more on Hurricane Nolo that could cause catastrophic flooding in Hawaii.

item.title: Cheetah cubs survive powerful storms, mother's illness at zoo
item.description: It might take a year before it's clear the cubs will survive the crucial period after their birth, the zoo's curator said.

item.title: Jane Doe who accused Jay-Z of sexual assault formally recants her claims
item.description: The anonymous woman who accused Jay-Z of sexually assaulting her said in a new court filing that she never met the rap mogul.

item.title: Exclusive discounts from CBS Mornings Deals
item.description: On this edition of CBS Deals, we show you items that will help improve your everyday lifestyle. Visit cbsdeals.com to take advantage of these exclusive deals today. CBS earns commissions on purchases made through cbsdeals.com.

item.title: Sylvester Stallone credits "divine guidance" for writing "Rocky" in 3 days
item.description: Sylvester Stallone reflected on writing his 1976 film "Rocky" in three and a half days. He told CBS Sunday Morning's Tracy Smith he had "to give credence to some sort of divine guidance" for his creative breakthrough.

item.title: H.R. McMaster says end of Cuban regime would "be a great thing" for Western Hemisphere
item.description: Retired Lt. Gen. H.R. McMaster shares his thoughts on Chinese President Xi Jinping's state visit at the White House and a memo obtained by CBS News suggesting the U.S. military is laying the groundwork for possible action around Cuba.

item.title: Lainey Wilson remembers Dolly Parton's legacy of love and service
item.description: Country music star Lainey Wilson spoke with "Entertainment Tonight" correspondent Cassie DiLaura about the lessons she learned from her close friendship with Dolly Parton.

item.title: "American Idol" alum Caleb Flynn's former mistress reads texts during murder trial
item.description: Former "American Idol" contestant Caleb Flynn is on trial for allegedly killing his wife and staging an elaborate crime scene. Flynn's former mistress testified at the trial. Ian Lee has the latest details.

item.title: Was Netanyahu's fiery U.N. speech aimed at his own political survival?
item.description: Israel's embattled leader lashed out at New York's mayor in a heated U.N. address, but a veteran analyst says his real targets were Israeli voters and President Trump.

item.title: What to know about Taylor Swift's "Patient Zero" and "The Life of a Showgirl: The Encore"
item.description: Taylor Swift released four new tracks on "The Life of a Showgirl: The Encore," a deluxe edition of her latest record. Swiftie Jo Ling Kent shares her thoughts.

item.title: How Dolly Parton still helps kids with cancer
item.description: Throughout her life, Dolly Parton helped children battling cancer with donations and visits to cheer kids up. A Knoxville, Tennessee, children's hospital named after her is carrying that legacy forward.

item.title: U.S. military lays groundwork for potential action around Cuba
item.description: Some units would "possibly [be] needed in 90-120 days," according to an internal Army message reviewed by CBS News.

item.title: New bill would lower Social Security retirement age for some workers
item.description: Workers in physically demanding jobs should be able to collect full Social Security retirement benefits at age 60, a Michigan lawmaker says.

item.title: ICE wasted millions in rapid push to expand detention capacity, watchdog finds
item.description: With an unprecedented budget, ICE spent billions in a rush to expand its detention network, wasting millions in the process, the Government Accountability Office found.

item.title: Alleged Guatemalan drug lord "The Iceman" extradited to Texas
item.description: Federal authorities extradited four alleged drug traffickers from Guatemala to North Texas, including a suspected kingpin known as "The Iceman."

item.title: U.S. troops help Ecuador arrest dozens linked to ruthless cartel
item.description: The operation "was conducted jointly with U.S. troops and the Drug Enforcement Administration (DEA)," Ecuador's interior minister said.

item.title: Why the bond market is freaking out, and what it means for your money
item.description: Investors are increasingly nervous about rising inflation, which could require the Federal Reserve to hike interest rates.
